test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

This institute is offering a new online course in Entrepreneurship.

options.text: A new online course in Entrepreneurship is being offered by this institute.
A new online course in Entrepreneurship has offered this institute.
A new online course in Entrepreneurship is offered by this institute.
A new online course in Entrepreneurship has been offered by this institute.

solution:
The correct answer is- 'A new online course in Entrepreneurship is being offered by this institute.'
